resolutions.target_artifact: openspec/changes/foundation-and-packaging/design.md — Decision 6 command block (lines 198–204) and 'The live checkout is never read by Pi' (line 215)
resolutions.rationale: Minor and correct: the block runs `pi` with the live checkout as cwd, and Pi treats cwd as the project directory (project `.pi/` is an auto-discovery root for trusted projects, Chidi §4). Today the live `.pi/` holds only `marbleization/` and `tasks/` (no `extensions/`, no `settings.json`), so the claim holds by circumstance. Measured the fix: running Pi from inside the copy (`cd "$D"`) with `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$D"` passes identically (usage header printed, no match), and the copy has no `.pi/` because it is excluded locally. I also settled the critic's two unverified assumptions: bsdtar 3.5.3 re-extraction overwrites the control-modified file and keeps `settings.json`/`out.txt`; after undo, Pi loads clean again (no stale transpile cache — `loader.js` creates jiti with `moduleCache: false`, Chidi §2). Recorded; the corrections: add `cd "$D"` after the `tar` line, write `out.txt` relative, use `git -C <repo> archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"` for the undo, and reword line 215 to 'Pi loads the package only from the copy, and its project directory is the copy; the live checkout is never modified.'
resolutions.evidence: Live `ls -a .pi/` → marbleization, tasks only. Control A → 1; `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"` → session-tree.ts restored (`rg -c '_pi.on("session_tree"'` = 1), settings.json and out.txt present; re-run → no match. `tar --version` bsdtar 3.5.3.
